scope: Source-backed failure rendering and turn finalization

checks.subject: Terminal-only failure propagation
checks.reason: ReportTerminalFailure appears only in FinalizeAndReturn with an explicit terminalFailureReason; CompleteFailedSourceBackedPipeline supplies that reason. Intermediate Emit failed events do not change terminal outcome.

checks.subject: Cancellation and expected insufficiency
checks.reason: OperationCanceledException is rethrown by source-backed orchestration; provider cancellation and request timeout preserve their own types. Recoverable polling validation is not a terminal report; expected insufficiency finalizes without terminalFailureReason.

checks.subject: Backend versus local model origin
checks.reason: LocalLlmUnavailableException is created only at the local model provider HTTP boundary, not by a backend failure passed to terminal handling.

checks.subject: No stale sources on terminal model failure
checks.reason: Failure completion clears LastSourcesUsed, LastToolNames and LastRagQueries and returns null sources.

finding.observedInCode: BuildLocalModelUnavailable directed the user to check the model address in Settings, while UserSettingsDialog exposes no URL editor.
finding.parentApprovedFrench: Vérifiez que l’assistant local est démarré, puis réessayez. Si le problème persiste, contactez votre intégrateur.

limits: This review does not execute the production UI or replace native W06 retest.
